Ganga Hospital Open Injury Score ( GHOISS ) is a score developed to prognosticate limb salvage and outcome measures in Type III B Open tibial fractures. A Type III B Injury involves injury to :
1) Covering tissues,
2) Functional tissues and
3) Bones

A true prognosticating score must evaluate each component separately and also collectively and GHOISS was developed to fulfil this criteria. The score was developed after systematic review of 88 Open Injury cases of the lower limb and their 5 year follow up at Ganga Hospital, Coimbatore.

Advantages of GHOISS :
1) It acts as a predictable single scoring system for limb salvage and gives guidelines for management
2) It has a very high inter-observer agreement rate
3) It evaluates the severity of injury to each component
4) Co-morbid factors are also included to evaluate the outcome
5) Has a high degree of sensitivity and specificity in guiding towards salvaging or amputating the injured limb

Los antimicrobianos son un grupo muy amplio de fármacos extraordinariamente eficaces y complejos. Desde su descubrimiento hace 70 años, han salvado millones de vidas y permitido avances médicos, convirtiéndose en medicamentos indispensables para el tratamiento de la mayoría de los procesos infecciosos bacterianos.

El desarrollo de resistencias a los antimicrobianos, la aparición y diseminación de bacterias multirresistentes y la escasez de tratamientos alternativos, son uno de los mayores problemas de salud pública en la actualidad. Aunque son muchos los factores que favorecen la selección y diseminación de la resistencia a los antibióticos, el uso inapropiado e indiscriminado de los mismos es uno de los factores principales que contribuyen a este fenómeno.

La utilización de antimicrobianos en el medio hospitalario es mejorable en el 30-50% de los casos. La existencia de microorganismos resistentes y su variabilidad entre hospitales e incluso dentro de las diferentes áreas de un mismo hospital hace necesario un buen conocimiento de la epidemiología microbiológica local. La selección óptima del antimicrobiano y su posología en los diferentes síndromes infecciosos requieren también una formación específica y actualizada.

Con el ánimo de promover una utilización más adecuada de los antimicrobianos la Comisión de Infección Hospitalaria del Hospital Son Espases (Palma de Mallorca, España) ha actualizado con esta tercera edición los protocolos de actuación en enfermedades infecciosas.

Con el formato app del manual de protocolos queremos facilitar la difusión y utilización de estos protocolos, y hacerlos accesibles y de fácil lectura para que resulten de utilidad en la práctica clínica diaria. También se puede acceder a los protocolos completos con su bibliografía desde la página de inicio para un estudio más detenido.

Get accurate, comprehensive, and user-friendly information on ending a pregnancy. Written in easy-to-understand and nonjudgmental language, the Safe Abortion app can also help people needing or giving post-abortion care. Free, discreet and small to download, this app includes 11 languages and works offline. 
Use the pregnancy calculator to learn what options are available—including abortion with pills—by number of weeks. Helpful illustrations offer clear instructions on how to use abortion pills. Vetted by professionals and tested by health workers, Safe Abortion is trusted by reproductive health advocates and accompaniers worldwide. We do not collect any personal information so your health data will never be sold or shared.  
INSIDE THE APP: 
•	Find clear and complete descriptions of safe abortion methods: abortion with pills, suction, and dilation and evacuation 
•	Get information on the correct doses for and ways to use misoprostol pills (with or without mifepristone) for medication abortions at different weeks 
•	Learn what to expect during and after an abortion, including how to respond to warning signs if they arise 
•	Prepare and plan for safely managing an abortion with a checklist, and find suggestions for how to care for your body and feelings 
•	Explore “for your country” information to find organizations that can help as well as links to relevant legal regulations  
•	Listen to information with the read aloud feature when using the app in English, Spanish or French 
FAQs offer quick reference to other health information like how soon you can get pregnant after an abortion, whether an abortion can affect pregnancies in the future, when monthly bleeding resumes, what birth control methods are there if you do not want to become pregnant again, and other common questions about abortion. 
Language choices in the app are Afaan Oromoo, Amharic, English, Español, Français, Igbo, Kinyarwanda, Kiswahili, Luganda, Português, and Yoruba. Change between all 11 languages at any time.  
DISCREET. WORKS OFFLINE & SMALL TO DOWNLOAD  
To be used by individuals, health workers, and advocates, Safe Abortion from Hesperian Health Guides is small to download (under 40mb) and designed to ensure user privacy.  
•	On your device the name beneath the app icon shows only as “SA”  
•	After downloading, Safe Abortion works fully offline without a data plan or internet access  
•	We do not collect any personal information!  
The Safe Abortion App from Hesperian Health Guides complements and supports the work of activists, organizations and collectives who make sure people all over the world have access to safe abortion.
